title: Decoding Zero Polynomial Circuits
statement: For every bit string $x$, membership in the language of encodings of nonempty, well-formed arithmetic circuits whose associated integer-coefficient polynomial is zero is equivalent to the existence of a circuit code that decodes from $x$, is well formed, and has associated polynomial equal to zero.
